description: Adds tap tempo, tempo locking and a clock to the Delay module immediately to its left

params.text: Tap it in time and the interval between taps becomes the tempo, which is handed to the Delay
Locks the Delay's time to note divisions of the tapped or incoming tempo while it is on
Clears the tapped tempo and puts the sync phase back to the start, which is how you line it up again with an outside clock

inputs.text: Takes the tempo from the interval between pulses arriving here
Puts the sync phase back to the start on a trigger, without a button having to be pressed

outputs.text: A pulse at the Delay's current time interval

notes: it must touch the right-hand edge of a Delay with no gap; on its own it processes nothing
the lamp beside the sync button shows whether locking is on, and it only answers once a Delay is found beside it
